title: Targ and Puthoff publish in Nature and write Mind-Reach
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Targ and Puthoff publish in Nature and write Mind-Reach, about 1972 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 1972 uh Russell tar and uh Hal put off Dr Hal put off uh wrote an article that I think it was called nature magazine then they wrote a book called Mind reach

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man who appeared on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025, says that around 1972 two scientists, Russell Targ and Dr. Hal Puthoff, wrote an article in what he thinks was Nature, a well-known science journal, and then a book called Mind-Reach. He tells it as a turning point in the story of their research, since getting into a major journal would mean serious science was taking their work seriously.
